values.note: Grace Outside's 2026 campsite rates: water/electric $40 a night ($35 a night for 6+ nights), full hookup (water/30-20 electric/sewer) $50 ($45 for 6+ nights). Extra tent $20/night; EV charging $20 per stay; up to 8 people per site.

fees.source: https://graceoutside.org/lake-michigan-campground/ ('2026 Individual Reservations'; 'Water/electric hook-up: $40 per night ($35 each for 6+ nights)'; 'Full-Hook-Up (water/30-20 electric/sewer): $50 per night'), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://graceoutside.org/lake-michigan-campground/campsites/ ('All sites have water or shared water access', '30 amp', '50 amp', 'Full hook-up, a limited number of sites have sewer, water and 30 amp service'), read 2026-10-22

facilities.source: https://graceoutside.org/lake-michigan-campground/ ('newly-constructed bath houses for restrooms & showers') + /facilities/ ('Brand new bathhouses were built in 2023'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 'All reservations must be made by phone or email' (231-869-5627, 231-690-1646, info@lakemichigancamp.org); availability can be checked first on the site's interactive map, and 'Final reservations must be confirmed by phone.' Open to the public ('Everyone is welcome'); no program enrolment. A limited number of seasonal RV sites are also sold.

booking.source: https://graceoutside.org/lake-michigan-campground/campsites/ ('All reservations must be made by phone or email. Use the button to check availability') + https://graceoutside.org/lake-michigan-campground/ ('Final reservations must be confirmed by phone') + /facilities/ ('Everyone is welcome to this family friendly campground'), read 2026-10-22

note: Former United Methodist camp (now a Grace Outside property) at 5807 Ridge Rd south of Pentwater, open to the public; wooded sites on 150 acres of forest and dunes with a half-mile private Lake Michigan beach via stairs/boardwalk (no lifeguard). Also cabins, platform tents, bunkhouses and a retreat center; disc golf, mini golf, playgrounds. --Claude
summary: Grace Outside's pages confirm public RV/tent sites ('Everyone is welcome'; reservations by phone or email, no program enrolment), 2026 water/electric $40 and full hookup $50 (6+ nights $5 less), 30/50-amp with a limited number of full-hookup sites, new 2023 bathhouses with showers, 2026 season May 15 - Oct 18; phone 231-869-5627 matches. Site count (~100) not stated by the operator; left. Note trimmed of hookup/count/booking text.
flags: Seasonal share: 'A limited number of seasonal RV sites are offered'; nightly sites are the norm. Price gate: base $40 (water/electric), full hookup $50, at the US$50 line; no gateway within 40 km (Grand Rapids 108 km); the family has not stayed here.
